profile.name: Ndanji Nachangwa
profile.title: Aeronautical Engineer · Head of Innovation
profile.role: Head of Innovation @ Robotix Institute ZM
profile.tagline: Engineering ideas into impact through STEM, innovation and education.
profile.bio: Aeronautical Engineer, innovation leader and STEM education advocate based in Lusaka Province, Zambia. Her work connects engineering, technology, education, fundraising, communication and people-centred innovation.
profile.quote: Building opportunities through engineering, innovation and education.

home.headline: Engineering ideas into impact.
home.intro: Building at the intersection of engineering, innovation, STEM education and community impact.
home.aboutText: Ndanji works at the intersection of engineering, technology, education and social impact. Her focus is on turning ideas into practical initiatives, creating opportunities for young people and supporting stronger participation in STEM.

about.headline: Engineer. Innovator. STEM advocate.
about.summary: My work connects engineering, innovation and education with opportunities that help young people build, experiment and lead.
about.secondary: My professional path brings together innovation leadership, project development, digital communication, fundraising and an aeronautical engineering foundation.

experience.description: Innovation leadership supporting robotics, STEM, technology and institutional initiatives.
Supporting fundraising, resource mobilisation, partnerships and strategic coordination for impact-focused work.
Managing digital communication and content to strengthen visibility, outreach and engagement.
Supporting creative direction, communication and programme storytelling.
Coordinating practical programmes, learners, partners and delivery activities.

impact.title: Northmead Primary School STEAM Project
impact.description: Project leadership for 40 Grade 6 learners who developed five functional STEAM prototypes including robotics, automation and smart-system projects.

impact.title: Technovation Girls
impact.description: Volunteer coaching supporting young women in technology and entrepreneurship. A senior team progressed to the Global Semifinals.

impact.title: STEM-A-Girl Robotics Outreach
impact.description: Hands-on STEM and robotics outreach designed to build confidence, practical skills and participation for girls in technology.

impact.title: REMP 55 Days Across Zambia
impact.description: 55 days of field work supporting the Rural Electrification Master Plan upgrade and learning directly from communities across Zambia.

impact.title: Techtrends Zambia 2024 Tech Expo
impact.description: Volunteering and public engagement focused on people-centred innovation, collaboration and digital transformation.

insights.title: STEM is Pink: Reimagining STEM Beyond Stereotypes
insights.summary: A reflection on representation, participation and changing the way girls and women see themselves in STEM.

contact.headline: Let’s build something meaningful.
contact.text: Open to conversations around engineering, innovation, STEM education, partnerships and public-interest technology.
